stories.title: Russian drone strike near Kyiv kills at least 27
stories.summary: At least 27 people have died after a Russian drone struck a warehouse near Kyiv’s western suburbs overnight, sparking a huge fire and explosions, authorities said on Saturday. The warehouse appeared to have been storing “explosive objects”, Ukrainian prosecutors said, opening an investigation into criminal negligence. stories.headline: China-Nepal floods: police officer filmed guiding people away from stricken border post

opening: Video footage taken moments before a catastrophic mudslide hit a border post in Tibet shows how one police officer stationed there tried to guide civilians to safety.
The clip, which shows the officer trying to direct people away from the police station at Gyirong Port, went viral online in China over the weekend.
body: State broadcaster CCTV said the officer, whom it named as Huang Peng, also rushed into a nearby tourist service centre to tell those inside to evacuate.
